omi:
**A 2nd brain you trust more than your 1st**
Omi captures your screen and conversations, transcribes in real-time, generates summaries and action items, and gives you an AI chat that remembers everything you've seen and heard. Works on desktop, phone and wearables.
based-chess-rs: **Neutron-o1** - A chess engine written in Rust. Evaluates positions with a 60 KB neural network, trained on games played against itself. ~2800 Elo.
agent-sandbox: Containment for tool-using agents. The model still picks the tool. This process decides whether it may run, pins HTTPS away from private addresses, runs child binaries inside systemd-run cgroups (Linux) or sandbox-exec (macOS), strips secrets, and appends a hash-chained audio digest.
KytyPS5: PlayStation 5 emulator for Windows, Linux and MacOS. CI/CD pipelines for Windows and Linux.
polymarket-model: CMF-2 50M. Weights on huggingface.co/shubhxho/cmf-2. Dataset on huggingface.co/datasets/shubhxho/cmf-15m-binance.
visionary-mlx: MLX video tokenizer, action-conditioned world model, and imagination-trained agent. Reinforcement Learning.
Unlimited-OCR-mlx: Native Apple Silicon inference for Baidu Unlimited-OCR. MLX-VLM dedicated unlimited-vlm pipeline for long-horizon document parsing.
speall: One search field over the open neuroscience archives. Ingests public dataset metadata from seven archives, normalizes modality and species vocabularies.
t3code: Agent harness control surface. Control agents on your machine with a mobile app (iOS, Android, web).
